upsert.title: Agentware 2026
upsert.summary: 72-hour online hackathon to build an autonomous agent you can walk away from. Runs 27-30 Nov 2026; team formation closes 23 Nov 2026 and code freeze/submission is 30 Nov 2026, 18:00 UTC.
upsert.eligibility: Online and open to participants worldwide; teams of 1-4. No country restriction stated.

prize.description: US$1,800 total cash pool: 1st US$800, 2nd US$400, 3rd US$200, Best Kill Switch US$100, plus a US$300 'Near Miss' side quest (3 x US$100).

notes: Details read from the organiser's announcement post on DEV; the separate event site was not opened. Near Miss write-up due 7 Dec 2026, 18:00 UTC.
